runtime_candidates.cpu_only_policy: Adapter always supplies -ngl 0 and rejects any result that does not report n_gpu_layers=0.
runtime_candidates.network_policy: Local artifact path only; provider repository/token acquisition flags are prohibited by profile validation.

runtime_candidates.reason: The pinned 0.10.5 source tree and current code search did not expose a current llamafile-bench entry point. Older benchmark-interface claims are not reused as current T030 authority.

decision: Implement the profile-driven portable CPU benchmark adapter with the proven llama-bench interface. Do not manufacture a llamafile adapter until a current stable interface is evidenced.
